The README is English, so the last pass over it is unslop, run after technical-writing has
settled the structure. technical-writing gives you the Diataxis shape and the sentence rules;
unslop then cuts the AI tells.

The corpus being Chinese does not change this: what matters is the language of the document
you are editing, not the language of the data it describes. When you translate the README
later, that Chinese version gets its own pass.
